title: gainz.fast — the inference optimization arena
excerpt: The open arena for LLM inference speed. Verified, reproducible speedups on real GPUs — NVIDIA DGX Spark GB10 and AMD Radeon AI PRO R9700, running vLLM and llama.cpp. Submit a kernel, get it benchmarked on trusted hardware, publish the gain.

FUND THE FRONTIER

real hardware.

Every track lives on a dedicated GPU box running around the clock — a DGX Spark GB10, a Radeon AI PRO R9700, and more as the arena grows. Submissions are free and always will be; if you want to help the frontier move faster, hardware and funding are what do it.

YOUR TURN

Bring your model.
Keep the proof.

gainz.fast separates fast local iteration from the trusted ranked run.
